theme: A wide-open day with the girls home in St. Pete.
greeting: Nothing is on the calendar today and all four girls are with you and Mike in St. Petersburg. The only clocks ticking are two travel bookings that have quietly slipped — ten minutes on those and the rest of the day is genuinely yours.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV is still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: Flagged to book this week back on Sep 14 and never done. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas is the thinnest rental in that market — a refundable hold now costs nothing and removes the whole risk; waiting genuinely costs money.

needsAttention.title: December break destination not picked
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by was Sep 30 and the Oct 15 book-by has passed. All four kids, Dec 13–Jan 2, six people over the holidays — inventory only thins from here. The call is domestic vs. international; make it and lock one.

needsAttention.title: ICGN panel to finalize before Toronto
needsAttention.detail: You moderate Plenary 7 on stewardship data next Thursday, Nov 5. Jane and Andy have signed off on your run-of-show; Rachit still owes revised questions — a nudge now gets the final flow set before you travel.

flagged.title: NACD New England event feedback
flagged.detail: Ellen Richstone forwarded a seasoned director's candid take on Tuesday's Maine event to the committee. A group thread — nothing owed from you.

inbox.noise: About eight retail and newsletter emails (Harry & David, Faherty, The Company Store, John Derian, Nextdoor, Press Herald) — all skippable.
inbox.clear: Inbox is otherwise quiet this morning.
